arms.better: tm found the relevant completion code, but repeated reads/searches caused all three attempts to stop before making a change; the hidden regression test consequently failed. Improve the repeated-inspection recovery path so tm suggests or resumes a focused edit rather than retrying essentially the same exploration three times, and avoid describing each reset attempt as a fresh investigation. The message exposes `tm --resume S-1` etc., but users may be confused that a ticket run is marked failed/escalated and requires manual session resumption with a different command.

OpenCode identified the shared backing-array append, copied the args before appending, added regression coverage, and clearly reported its targeted test and diff check. The independently checked-out PR test passed. It could be improved by running the full `go test ./...` suite itself rather than only the targeted test; the full suite also passed independently after installing the hidden PR test.
